title: clear empties the cast and leaves everything else standing
why: The whole definition of the op is which things it does NOT touch. It removes every actor and obj — the same removal `show=false` performs, not a dim — while the backdrop stays exactly as it was, so a scene transition is still `clear` + a new `bg` and never an accidental black screen. A renderer that also dropped the backdrop, or that hid the cast by fading it, would satisfy the forwarding case and still be wrong.
